material_source_provenance: Ground truth read from the installed game's Material assets (Timberborn_Data/resources.assets, 660 assemblies / 1536 Texture2D): each material's m_SavedProperties._MainTex (Texture2D name) and _Color tint, extracted 2026-10-27 with AssetStudioModCLI (materials enumerated via a small AssetStudio probe) and cross-checked against the runtime UV contract in Timberborn.PrefabOptimization.AutoAtlaser / AutoAtlasingPrefabOptimizer IL: a mesh UV is remapped as uv_atlas = uv_material * UVScale + UVOffset with UVScale = 1/sizeMultiplier, so normalized (u,v) inside the material's own _D texture is preserved (AutoAtlas or direct material, identical sampling). The _Color tint multiplies the sampled albedo. ART-07 addition (2026-10-27): AutoAtlaser.GenerateAutoAtlasFragments builds one atlas of 1024*sizeMultiplier and CombineFragments copies every fragment at its native 1024x1024 resolution, so a UV component > 1 leaves the material's own cell and samples another material - hence the ART-07 world UVs never leave the material canvas (see art/ART07_UV_TILING.md).
